high_level_description: The image shows a hand holding a bag of Lay's potato chips. The bag is predominantly green with red and yellow accents, featuring the Lay's logo prominently in the center. The flavor of the chips is labeled as "Vị Tảo Biển Nori," which translates to "Nori Seaweed" in English. The packaging also includes images of nori seaweed and sushi rolls, suggesting the flavor profile of the chips. In the background, there are shelves stocked with various other Lay's chip flavors, including some in blue and yellow packaging.
